intent.proves: Every active website selects a header and a footer page in its layout settings: its Swift-v2_Master website item names a desktop header page (item type Swift-v2_Header) and a desktop footer page (Swift-v2_Footer), and both pages exist and are not deleted.

bindings.reason: The website settings are an area item, not a page item; no allowlisted MCP read returns the HeaderDesktop and FooterDesktop fields of the area's Swift-v2_Master item.

bindings.query: SELECT CAST(a.AreaID AS nvarchar(20)) + N' ' + ISNULL(a.AreaName, N'') FROM Area a WHERE a.AreaActive = 1 AND ISNULL(a.AreaDeleted, 0) = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [ItemType_Swift-v2_Master] m JOIN Page h ON h.PageID = TRY_CAST(m.HeaderDesktop AS int) AND ISNULL(h.PageDeleted, 0) = 0 AND h.PageItemType = N'Swift-v2_Header' JOIN Page f ON f.PageID = TRY_CAST(m.FooterDesktop AS int) AND ISNULL(f.PageDeleted, 0) = 0 AND f.PageItemType = N'Swift-v2_Footer' WHERE a.AreaItemType = N'Swift-v2_Master' AND m.Id = a.AreaItemId)
bindings.subjectsQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Area WHERE AreaActive = 1 AND ISNULL(AreaDeleted, 0) = 0

sources.ref: A 10.30.6 Swift 2 host, read-only, 2026-11-13: Area 1 'Swift 2' AreaItemType Swift-v2_Master, item 1 HeaderDesktop 91 (Swift-v2_Header), FooterDesktop 90 (Swift-v2_Footer); the page-select fields store the page id as text.
